First, we distribute the $3$ over each of the terms in parentheses.

$$
\begin{aligned}(5-y)\cdot 3-10 & = \\ 5\cdot 3+(-y)\cdot 3-10 & = \\ (15)+(-3y)-10 & = \\ 15-3y-10\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we collect like terms.

$$
\begin{aligned}15-3y-10 & = \\ (15-10)-3y & = \\ 5-3y\end{aligned}
$$
